title: ELYSIUM I - Riva 110' Dolcevita
highlights: First and only owner since new
Stainless-steel frame for huge main-deck windows
description:
ELYSIUM I is a 33.5-metre performance raised-pilothouse yacht from Riva's successful 110 Dolcevita line, maintained to an outstanding condition since new by her first and only owner. Built to commercial coding, she completed her five-year survey in 2024.

A stainless-steel structural framework under her superstructure allows exceptionally large main-deck windows, flooding the salon with light. She offers five guest cabins and three crew cabins and is lying in Palma, Spain.
